1.english_reference: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨סֶף֙ אַף יְהוָ֔ה לַ חֲר֖וֹת בְּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: Καὶ προσέθετο ὀργὴν Κύριος ἐκκαῆναι ἐν Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Et áddidit furor Dómini irásci contra Israel ,
traditions.KJV: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel ,

1.english_reference: and he moved David against them to say ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨סֶת אֶת דָּוִ֤ד בָּ הֶם֙ לֵ אמֹ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπέσεισεν τὸν Δαυεὶδ ἐν αὐτοῖς λέγων
traditions.VUL: commovítque David in eis dicéntem :
traditions.KJV: and he moved David against them to say ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ֛ךְ מְנֵ֥ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ אֶת יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: Βάδιζε ἀρίθμησον τὸν Ἰσραὴλ καὶ τὸν Ἰουδά .
traditions.VUL: Vade , númera Israel et Iudam .
traditions.KJV: Go , number Israel and Judah .

2.english_reference: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which [ was ] with him

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶל יוֹאָ֣ב שַׂר הַ חַ֣יִל אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֗ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς πρὸς Ἰωὰβ ἄρχοντα τῆς ἰσχύος τὸν μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: Dixítque rex ad Ioab príncipem exércitus sui :
traditions.KJV: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host , which [ was ] with him ,

2.english_reference: Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba

traditions.WLC: שֽׁוּט נָ֞א בְּ כָל שִׁבְטֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִ דָּן֙ וְ עַד בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע
traditions.LXX: Δίελθε δὴ πάσας φυλὰς Ἰσραὴλ ἀπὸ Δὰν καὶ ἕως Βηρσάβεε
traditions.VUL: Perámbula omnes tribus Israel a Dan usque Bersabée ,
traditions.KJV: Go now through all the tribes of Israel , from Dan even to Beersheba ,

2.english_reference: and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people

traditions.WLC: וּ פִקְד֖וּ אֶת הָ עָ֑ם וְ יָ֣דַעְתִּ֔י אֵ֖ת מִסְפַּ֥ר הָ עָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπίσκεψαι τὸν λαόν , καὶ γνώσομαι τὸν ἀριθμὸν τοῦ λαοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et numeráte pópulum , ut sciam númerum eius .
traditions.KJV: and number ye the people , that I may know the number of the people .

3.english_reference: And Joab said unto the king

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹאָ֜ב אֶל הַ מֶּ֗לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰωὰβ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα
traditions.VUL: Dixítque Ioab regi :
traditions.KJV: And Joab said unto the king ,

3.english_reference: Now the LORD thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see [ it ]

traditions.WLC: וְ יוֹסֵ֣ף יְהוָה֩ אֱלֹהֶ֨י ךָ אֶל הָ עָ֜ם כָּ הֵ֤ם וְ כָ הֵם֙ מֵאָ֣ה פְעָמִ֔ים וְ עֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽ י הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ רֹא֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: Καὶ προσθείη Κύριος ὁ θεὸς πρὸς τὸν λαὸν ὥσπερ αὐτοὺς καὶ ὥσπερ αὐτοὺς ἑκατονταπλασίονα , καὶ ὀφθαλμοὶ τοῦ κυρίου μου τοῦ βασιλέως ὁρῶντες ·
traditions.VUL: Adáugeat Dóminus Deus tuus ad pópulum tuum , quantus nunc est , iterúmque centúplicet in conspéctu dómini mei regis :
traditions.KJV: Now the LORD thy God add unto the people , how many soever they be , an hundredfold , and that the eyes of my lord the king may see [ it ] :

3.english_reference: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing ?

traditions.WLC: וַ אדֹנִ֣ י הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ לָ֥ מָּה חָפֵ֖ץ בַּ דָּבָ֥ר הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁ κύριός μου ὁ βασιλεὺς ἵνα τί βούλεται ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τούτῳ ?
traditions.VUL: sed quid sibi dóminus meus rex vult in re huiuscémodi ?
traditions.KJV: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing ?

4.english_reference: Notwithstanding the king ’s word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host

traditions.WLC: וַ יֶּחֱזַ֤ק דְּבַר הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶל יוֹאָ֔ב וְ עַ֖ל שָׂרֵ֣י הֶ חָ֑יִל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑπερίσχυσεν ὁ λόγος τοῦ βασιλέως πρὸς Ἰωὰβ καὶ εἰς τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῆς δυνάμεως ·
traditions.VUL: Obtínuit autem sermo regis verba Ioab , et príncipum exércitus :
traditions.KJV: Notwithstanding the king ’s word prevailed against Joab , and against the captains of the host .

4.english_reference: And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵ֨א יוֹאָ֜ב וְ שָׂרֵ֤י הַ חַ֨יִל֙ לִ פְנֵ֣י הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ לִ פְקֹ֥ד אֶת הָ עָ֖ם אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ἰωὰβ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες τῆς ἰσχύος ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως ἐπισκέψασθαι τὸν λαὸν Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: egressúsque est Ioab , et príncipes mílitum a fácie regis , ut numerárent pópulum Israel .
traditions.KJV: And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king , to number the people of Israel .

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעַבְר֖וּ אֶת הַ יַּרְדֵּ֑ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ διέβησαν τὸν Ἰορδάνην ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque pertransíssent Iordánem ,
traditions.KJV: And they passed over Jordan ,

5.english_reference: and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that [ lieth ] in the midst of the river of Gad

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּחֲנ֣וּ בַ עֲרוֹעֵ֗ר יְמִ֥ין הָ עִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּ תוֹךְ הַ נַּ֥חַל הַ גָּ֖ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Ἀροὴλ ἐκ δεξιῶν τῆς πόλεως τῆς ἐν μέσῳ τῆς φάραγγος Γὰδ
traditions.VUL: venérunt in Aroer ad déxteram urbis , quæ est in valle Gad :
traditions.KJV: and pitched in Aroer , on the right side of the city that [ lieth ] in the midst of the river of Gad ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶל יַעְזֵֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἐλιέζερ .
traditions.KJV: and toward Jazer :

6.english_reference: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtimhodshi

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ הַ גִּלְעָ֔דָ ה וְ אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ תַּחְתִּ֖ים חָדְשִׁ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθον εἰς τὴν Γαλαὰδ καὶ εἰς τὴν Θαβασὼν ἥ ἐστιν Ναδασαί ,
traditions.VUL: et per Iazer transiérunt in Gálaad , et in terram inferiórem Hodsi ,
traditions.KJV: Then they came to Gilead , and to the land of Tahtimhodshi ;

6.english_reference: and they came to Danjaan, and about to Zidon

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ דָּ֣נָ ה יַּ֔עַן וְ סָבִ֖יב אֶל צִידֽוֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρεγένοντο εἰς Δὰν Εἰδὰν καὶ Οὐδάν , καὶ ἐκύκλωσαν εἰς Σιδῶνα ·
traditions.VUL: et venérunt in Dan silvéstria . Circumeuntésque iuxta Sidónem ,
traditions.KJV: and they came to Danjaan , and about to Zidon ,

7.english_reference: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ מִבְצַר צֹ֔ר וְ כָל עָרֵ֥י הַ חִוִּ֖י וְ הַֽ כְּנַעֲנִ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθαν εἰς Μάψαρ Τύρου καὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις τοῦ Εὑαίου καὶ τοῦ Χαναναίου ·
traditions.VUL: transiérunt prope mœ́nia Tyri , et omnem terram Hevǽi et Chananǽi ,
traditions.KJV: And came to the strong hold of Tyre , and to all the cities of the Hivites , and of the Canaanites :

7.english_reference: and they went out to the south of Judah, [ even ] to Beersheba

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּֽצְא֛וּ אֶל נֶ֥גֶב יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθαν κατὰ νότον Ἰούδα εἰς Βηρσάβεε ,
traditions.VUL: venerúntque ad merídiem Iuda in Bersabée :
traditions.KJV: and they went out to the south of Judah , [ even ] to Beersheba .

8.english_reference: So when they had gone through all the land

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּשֻׁ֖טוּ בְּ כָל הָ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ περιώδευσαν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ ·
traditions.VUL: et lustráta univérsa terra ,
traditions.KJV: So when they had gone through all the land ,

8.english_reference: they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֜אוּ מִ קְצֵ֨ה תִשְׁעָ֧ה חֳדָשִׁ֛ים וְ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים י֖וֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρεγένοντο ἀπὸ τέλους ἐννέα μηνῶν καὶ εἴκοσι ἡμερῶν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ ·
traditions.VUL: affuérunt post novem menses et vigínti dies in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days .

9.english_reference: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתֵּ֥ן יוֹאָ֛ב אֶת מִסְפַּ֥ר מִפְקַד הָ עָ֖ם אֶל הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν Ἰωὰβ τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῆς ἐπισκέψεως τοῦ λαοῦ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ·
traditions.VUL: Dedit ergo Ioab númerum descriptiónis pópuli regi ,
traditions.KJV: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king :

9.english_reference: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword

traditions.WLC: וַ תְּהִ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל שְׁמֹנֶה֩ מֵא֨וֹת אֶ֤לֶף אִֽישׁ חַ֨יִל֙ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חֶ֔רֶב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο Ἰσραὴλ ὀκτακόσιαι χιλιάδες ἀνδρῶν δυνάμεως σπωμένων ῥομφαίαν ,
traditions.VUL: et invénta sunt de Israel octingénta míllia virórum fórtium , qui edúcerent gládium ,
traditions.KJV: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword ;

9.english_reference: and the men of Judah [ were ] five hundred thousand men

traditions.WLC: וְ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה חֲמֵשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνὴρ Ἰούδα πεντακόσιαι χιλιάδες ἀνδρῶν μαχητῶν .
traditions.VUL: et de Iuda quingénta míllia pugnatórum .
traditions.KJV: and the men of Judah [ were ] five hundred thousand men .

10.english_reference: And David ’s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people .

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֤ךְ לֵב דָּוִד֙ אֹת֔ וֹ אַחֲרֵי כֵ֖ן סָפַ֣ר אֶת הָ עָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐπάταξεν καρδία Δαυεὶδ αὐτὸν μετὰ τὸ ἀριθμῆσαι τὸν λαόν ·
traditions.VUL: Percússit autem cor David eum , postquam numerátus est pópulus :
traditions.KJV: And David ’s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people .

10.english_reference: And David said unto the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶל יְהוָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυεὶδ πρὸς Κύριον
traditions.VUL: et dixit David ad Dóminum :
traditions.KJV: And David said unto the LORD ,

10.english_reference: I have sinned greatly in that I have done :

traditions.WLC: חָטָ֤אתִי מְאֹד֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי
traditions.LXX: Ἥμαρτον σφόδρα ὃ ἐποίησα ·
traditions.VUL: Peccávi valde in hoc facto :
traditions.KJV: I have sinned greatly in that I have done :

10.english_reference: and now , I beseech thee , O LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: νῦν , Κύριε ,
traditions.VUL: sed precor Dómine ,
traditions.KJV: and now , I beseech thee , O LORD ,

10.english_reference: take away the iniquity of thy servant ;

traditions.WLC: הַֽעֲבֶר נָא֙ אֶת עֲוֺ֣ן עַבְדְּ ךָ֔
traditions.LXX: παραβίβασον δὴ τὴν ἀνομίαν τοῦ δούλου σου ,
traditions.VUL: ut tránsferas iniquitátem servi tui ,
traditions.KJV: take away the iniquity of thy servant ;

10.english_reference: for I have done very foolishly .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י נִסְכַּ֖לְתִּי מְאֹֽד
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐμωράνθην σφόδρα .
traditions.VUL: quia stulte egi nimis .
traditions.KJV: for I have done very foolishly .

11.english_reference: For when David was up in the morning

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֥קָם דָּוִ֖ד בַּ בֹּ֑קֶר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέστη Δαυεὶδ τὸ πρωί ·
traditions.VUL: Surréxit ítaque David mane ,
traditions.KJV: For when David was up in the morning ,

11.english_reference: the word of the LORD came unto the prophet Gad

traditions.WLC: וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֗ה הָיָה֙ אֶל גָּ֣ד הַ נָּבִ֔יא
traditions.LXX: καὶ λόγος Κυρίου ἐγένετο πρὸς Γὰδ τὸν προφήτην
traditions.VUL: et sermo Dómini factus est ad Gad prophétam
traditions.KJV: the word of the LORD came unto the prophet Gad ,

traditions.WLC: חֹזֵ֥ה דָוִ֖ד
traditions.LXX: τὸν ὁρῶντα Δαυεὶδ
traditions.VUL: et Vidéntem David ,
traditions.KJV: David ’s seer ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: λέγων .
traditions.VUL: dicens :
traditions.KJV: saying ,

traditions.WLC: הָל֞וֹךְ וְ דִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֶל דָּוִ֗ד
traditions.LXX: Πορεύθητι καὶ λάλησον πρὸς Δαυεὶδ
traditions.VUL: Vade , et lóquere ad David :
traditions.KJV: Go and say unto David ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: λέγων Τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: שָׁלֹ֕שׁ אָנֹכִ֖י נוֹטֵ֣ל עָלֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: Τρία ἐγώ εἰμι αἴρω ἐπὶ σέ ,
traditions.VUL: Trium tibi datur óptio :
traditions.KJV: I offer thee three [ things ] ;

traditions.WLC: בְּחַר לְ ךָ֥ אַֽחַת מֵ הֶ֖ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔκλεξαι σεαυτῷ ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν
traditions.VUL: élige unum quod volúeris ex his ,
traditions.KJV: choose thee one of them ,

12.english_reference: that I may [ do it ] unto thee

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָּֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ποιήσω σοι .
traditions.VUL: ut fáciam tibi .
traditions.KJV: that I may [ do it ] unto thee .

13.english_reference: So Gad came to David , and told him , and said unto him

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹא גָ֥ד אֶל דָּוִ֖ד וַ יַּגֶּד ל֑ וֹ וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֡ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Γὰδ πρὸς Δαυείδ , καὶ ἀνήγγειλεν αὐτῷ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ
traditions.VUL: Cumque venísset Gad ad David , nuntiávit ei , dicens :
traditions.KJV: So Gad came to David , and told him , and said unto him ,

13.english_reference: Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ תָב֣וֹא לְ ךָ֣ שֶֽׁבַע שָׁנִ֣ים רָעָ֣ב בְּ אַרְצֶ֡ ךָ
traditions.LXX: Ἔκλεξαι σεαυτῷ γενέσθαι , εἰ ἔλθῃ σοι τρία ἔτη λιμὸς ἐν τῇ γῇ σου ,
traditions.VUL: Aut septem annis véniet tibi fames in terra tua :
traditions.KJV: Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land ?

13.english_reference: or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies , while they pursue thee ?

traditions.WLC: אִם שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳ֠דָשִׁים נֻסְ ךָ֨ לִ פְנֵֽי צָרֶ֜י ךָ וְ ה֣וּא רֹדְפֶ֗ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἢ τρεῖς μῆνας φεύγειν σε ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου καὶ ἔσονται διώκοντές σε ,
traditions.VUL: aut tribus ménsibus fúgies adversários tuos , et illi te persequéntur :
traditions.KJV: or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies , while they pursue thee ?

13.english_reference: or that there be three days ’ pestilence in thy land ?

traditions.WLC: וְ אִם הֱ֠יוֹת שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת יָמִ֥ים דֶּ֨בֶר֙ בְּ אַרְצֶ֔ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἢ γενέσθαι τρεῖς ἡμέρας θάνατον ἐν τῇ γῇ σου ·
traditions.VUL: aut certe tribus diébus erit pestiléntia in terra tua .
traditions.KJV: or that there be three days ’ pestilence in thy land ?

13.english_reference: now advise , and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me

traditions.WLC: עַתָּה֙ דַּ֣ע וּ רְאֵ֔ה מָה אָשִׁ֥יב שֹׁלְחִ֖ י דָּבָֽר
